description: Prepares a NEW letter to the same recipient as one of the person’s earlier letters (by reference), from the account’s saved return address, with the follow-up text you wrote with the person. It works exactly like prepare_certified_letter and returns a new review link: nothing from the earlier purchase carries over, and nothing is mailed or charged until the person reviews and pays for this new letter. Write the follow-up only after the person says no reply arrived or asks for one.

letter_text.description: The body of the follow-up you wrote with the person.

service.description: Optional. Defaults to CERTIFIED_ERR, whatever the earlier letter used.

name: create_followup_draft
title: Prepare a follow-up to an earlier letter
